dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.use-preference-constants-abbreviate-package-names>
<!description: Replace reference to 'JavaElementLabelComposer.APPEARANCE_ABBREVIATE_PACKAGE_NAMES' with 'PreferenceConstants.APPEARANCE_ABBREVIATE_PACKAGE_NAMES'. This uses the preferred constant from the central PreferenceConstants class.
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.viewers.JavaElementLabelComposer.APPEARANCE_ABBREVIATE_PACKAGE_NAMES
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.ui.PreferenceConstants.APPEARANCE_ABBREVIATE_PACKAGE_NAMES
;;
summary: Replaces a specific constant reference from `JavaElementLabelComposer` with its equivalent from `PreferenceConstants`.
